title: San Francisco Diwali Festival (Sunday, Nov 8)
description: Celebrate Diwali in San Francisco with live music, dance, and family fun! Presented by Yerba Buena Gardens
long_description:
Celebrate Diwali in San Francisco with live music, dance, and family fun! Presented by Yerba Buena Gardens

About this Event

The San Francisco Diwali Festival brings together contemporary and traditional South Asian performances for a vibrant outdoor celebration. Set in the beautiful , this free, all-ages event invites you to relax, dance, and celebrate Diwali.
Enjoy live performances throughout the day, along with a curated selection of local makers, artisan vendors, and delicious food. Bring your family and friends for an afternoon of music, culture, and celebration!

Yerba Buena Gardens, a beautiful haven in the heart of San Francisco’s downtown art district, lets you experience San Francisco on a human scale. With its acres of sprawling greenery, the Gardens is an easygoing spot for you and your family to play, dine, recreate, shop, and take it all in any time of year. 
Whether you want to visit a popular museum, sit in a theater or a café, view public art, hang out with your kids at The Fun Zone, or stroll the beautiful lawns and gardens, there’s always something new to experience and enjoy. Come visit our three city blocks, bordered by Third, Fourth, Market, and Folsom streets, any day of the year.
